gear: Doubles in finger-to-hand cams from about 0.4 up through a #3 Camalot, plus a few small nuts
A small offset cam is worth carrying to protect the pendulum-prone section between the two bolts on the pitch 4 face crux
Two bolts protect the pitch 4 face crux, described as run-out and taping up for the V-slot is recommended
70 m rope, both for leading the longer pitches and for the rappel descent
Descent is by rappelling the route itself, not a walk-off

Long slings and extra alpine draws to manage rope drag on the wandering, traversing pitches
Several belays use fixed chain anchors (pitch 3 at a tree, pitch 4 at a chain station)
Descend by rappelling the neighboring Free at Last line rather than walking off
